changelog.title: Published "The Perception of the Police in Online Media"
changelog.description: A data story reading a quarter-century of UK police coverage through word frequency, tone, themes and named entities — with an interactive year-by-year explorer and word clouds. Ships with illustrative sample data grounded in the documented record; a live build uses a free Guardian Open Platform key. The earliest years are deliberately flagged as thin and single-source.

changelog.title: Added this page — "How I built this website"
changelog.description: Created an open, plain-English explainer of every service the site uses and why, with this running change log beneath it. The idea: show the whole thing being learned in the open, mistakes and all, and invite suggestions.

changelog.title: Monthly police data refresh
changelog.description: The crime dashboard pulled in the latest stop-and-search and recorded-crime figures from data.police.uk. This happens automatically each month — I don't touch it by hand.

changelog.title: Published "Do you understand?"
changelog.description: A piece questioning whether the standard custody question actually serves a purpose. Written in the browser editor and published with one click.

changelog.title: Research Assistant and Crime Dashboard went live
changelog.description: Two interactive tools — a plain-language search over millions of academic papers, and a live crime-data explorer. The biggest things I've built so far, and the point where this stopped being just a blog.
